workflows.name: Working with Workspaces
workflows.description: GNOME gives you a fresh, empty desktop whenever you want one. These two keys are a pair: the first takes you away, the second brings you back to this window.

steps.heading: Move to the next workspace
steps.description: A new workspace is created as you need it, so there is always one more to the right. This window stays where it is — you are the one who moved.

steps.heading: Come back
steps.description: The same key in the other direction. If this window is no longer on screen when you get here, that is the shortcut working: press Ctrl+Alt+Left again until you see it, then click it to carry on.
